# This query retrieves Parmigiano dialect translations of Italian lemmas expressing the emotion of fear (paura) from the LiITA Lemma Bank using OntoLex-Lemon and related vocabularies.

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?italianWord ?dialectWord ?dialectName ?emotionLabel
WHERE {
    # Select Italian lemmas from the LiITA knowledge base
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma .
    # Get the written representation (form) of the Italian lemma
    ?italianLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
  
    # Link Italian lemma to emotion annotations via the ELITA ontology
    ?emotionLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    ?emotionLexEntry elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .
    # Retrieve the emotion label (e.g., "Paura")
    ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
  
    # Filter to only include the emotion of fear (paura)
    FILTER(STR(?emotionLabel) = "Paura")
  
    # Access lexical entries corresponding to Italian lemma canonical form
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
  
    # Use vartrans:translatableAs to find dialectal translations of the Italian lexical entry
    ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?dialectLexEntry .
    # For each dialect form, get its canonical lemma
    ?dialectLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?dialectLemma .
    # Identify the dialect lemma bank resource the dialect lemma belongs to
    ?dialectLemma dcterms:isPartOf ?dialectLemmaBank .
    # Get the written form of the dialect lemma
    ?dialectLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?dialectWord .
  
    # Filter to only include the Parmigiano dialect lemma bank
    FILTER(regex(str(?dialectLemmaBank), "Parmigiano", "i"))
  
    # Extract dialect name from the URI of the dialect lemma bank using regex string replacement
    BIND(REPLACE(STR(?dialectLemmaBank), "^.*/Dialetto([^/]+)/.*$", "$1") AS ?dialectName)
}
# Order results by emotion label, dialect name, then Italian word for clarity
ORDER BY ?emotionLabel ?dialectName ?italianWord
# Limit output to 100 results

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?italianWord ?parmigianoWord ?emotionLabel
WHERE {
    # Select Italian lemmas from the LiITA knowledge base
    GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
        ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                      ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    }

    # Link Italian lemma to emotion annotations via the ELITA ontology
    ?emotionEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    GRAPH <http://w3id.org/elita> {
        ?emotionEntry elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .
        ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
    }

    # Filter to only include sadness or surprise
    FILTER(STR(?emotionLabel) IN ("Tristezza", "Sorpresa"))

    # Access lexical entries corresponding to Italian lemma canonical form for translation
    ?translationEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .

    # Use vartrans:translatableAs to find Parmigiano dialect translations
    ?translationEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?parmigianoLexEntry .
    ?parmigianoLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?parmigianoLemma .

    # Identify Parmigiano lemma specifically and get its written form
    ?parmigianoLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                     ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord .
}
ORDER BY ?emotionLabel ?italianWord ?parmigianoWord

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?italianWord ?sicilianWord ?emotionLabel
WHERE {
    # Select Italian lemmas from the LiITA knowledge base
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma .
    # Get the written representation (form) of the Italian lemma
    ?italianLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
  
    # Link Italian lemma to emotion annotations via the ELITA ontology
    ?emotionLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    ?emotionLexEntry elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .
    # Retrieve the emotion label (e.g., "Rabbia", "Disgusto") 
    ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
  
    # Filter to only include anger and disgust
    FILTER(STR(?emotionLabel) IN ("Rabbia", "Disgusto"))
  
    # Access lexical entries corresponding to Italian lemma canonical form
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
  
    # Use vartrans:translatableAs to find Sicilian translations of the Italian lexical entry
    ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?sicilianLexEntry .
    # For each Sicilian form, get its canonical lemma
    ?sicilianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?sicilianLemma .
    # Identify the Sicilian lemma bank resource the Sicilian lemma belongs to
    ?sicilianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> .
    # Get the written form of the Sicilian lemma
    ?sicilianLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?sicilianWord .
}
# Order results by emotion label, then Italian word, then Sicilian word for clarity
ORDER BY ?emotionLabel ?italianWord ?sicilianWord
# Limit output to 100 results

SELECT ?italianWord
WHERE {
    SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
        ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?writtenRep ] .
        FILTER ( STR(?writtenRep) = "veicolo" ) .
        ?word ontolex:sense ?sense .
        ?sense lexinfo:hypernym ?hypoSense .
        ?hypoWord ontolex:sense ?hypoSense .
    }
    ?hypoWord ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
    GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
        ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                      ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    }
}

SELECT ?italianWord ?parmigianoWord ?italianLemma ?parmigianoLemma
WHERE {
    # Italian lemma "pane" from the main Italian LemmaBank
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                  ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord ;
                  dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/lemma/LemmaBank> .
    FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "pane")

    # Italian lexical entry linked to the lemma
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .

    # Translation link from Italian entry to Parmigiano entry (Italian → Dialect)
    ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?parmigianoLexEntry .

    # Parmigiano lexical entry, lemma, and written form
    ?parmigianoLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?parmigianoLemma .
    ?parmigianoLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord ;
                      dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank> .
}

# This query retrieves the definition(s) of the Italian lemma "terra" from the CompL-it resource in the LiITA knowledge base using OntoLex-Lemon structures.

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>  # OntoLex namespace for linguistic ontologies, including Lemmas, Forms, and Senses
PREFIX lime: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/lime#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>  # SKOS used here for definitions attached to senses
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?definition  # Select the definition linked to the sense of the lemma "terra"
WHERE {
    SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {  # Query the CompL-it specific endpoint within LiITA

            ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord ] ;  # ?word is a lexical entry with a canonical written form ?italianWord

                    ontolex:sense [ skos:definition ?definition ] .  # The lexical entry has one or more senses that have definitions

        FILTER ( STR(?italianWord) = "terra" ) .  # Filter lexical entries whose canonical form is exactly "terra"
  }
}
  # Limit results to at most 10 definitions

# This query retrieves lemmas and their definitions from the LiITA Lemma Bank in which the definition contains the word "terra".

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX lime: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/lime#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?writtenRep ?definition
WHERE {
  # Querying a remote SPARQL endpoint hosting the LiITA ontology data
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    # ?word is a lexical entry with at least one sense with a definition and a canonical written form
    ?word ontolex:sense [ skos:definition ?definition ] ;  # Access the sense blank node and its definition using the SKOS vocabulary
          ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?writtenRep ] . # Access the canonical form's written representation (lemma)

    # Filter to include only definitions containing the term "terra" (case insensitive)
    FILTER regex(?definition, "terra", "i")
  }
}
  # Limit to 30 results to avoid excessive output

PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?italianWord ?definition
WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                  lila:hasPOS lila:noun ;
                  ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?italianWord), "ità$"))
  }

  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?italianLexEntry ontolex:sense [ skos:definition ?definition ] .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?definition), "astratt", "i"))
  }

  ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
}
ORDER BY ?italianWord

PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?sicilianWord ?italianWord
WHERE {
  # Italian lemma "donna" in the Italian Lemma Bank
  ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
  FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "donna")

  # Italian lexical entry linked to the lemma
  ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .

  # Translation link: Italian entry -> Sicilian entry (correct direction)
  ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?sicilianLexEntry .
  ?sicilianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?sicilianLemma .

  # Sicilian lemma identified via Sicilian Lemma Bank
  ?sicilianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                 ontolex:writtenRep ?sicilianWord .

  # Filter for cognates: identical spelling in Italian and Sicilian
  FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = STR(?sicilianWord))
}
ORDER BY ?sicilianWord

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?italianWord ?parmigianoWord
WHERE {
  # Italian lemma with written representation "pane"
  ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
  FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "pane")

  # Italian lexical entry
  ?italianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .

  # Translation link from Italian to Parmigiano lexical entry
  ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?parmigianoLexEntry .

  # Parmigiano lexical entry to its lemma
  ?parmigianoLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?parmigianoLemma .

  # Identify Parmigiano lemma and get its written form
  ?parmigianoLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                   ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord .
}

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sense) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?writtenRep ] .
    FILTER(STR(?writtenRep) = "banco")
    ?word ontolex:sense ?sense .
  }
}

PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX lime: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/lime#>
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?italianWord (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sense) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
    ?italianLemma a lila:Lemma ;
                  ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "banco" || STR(?italianWord) = "piano" || STR(?italianWord) = "campo" || STR(?italianWord) = "punto")
  }
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord ] ;
          ontolex:sense ?sense .
  }
  ?word ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
}
GROUP BY ?italianWord
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?writtenRep (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sense) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?writtenRep ] .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?writtenRep), "^(capo|fine|corso)$", "i"))
    ?word ontolex:sense ?sense .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?writtenRep
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
